answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a Groth16 proof over a per-agent secret, so a sybil must mint distinct keys rather than clone one copper credential. Recursive aggregation over pasta curves lets peers verify a basalt-anchored registry of these proofs in sub-second latency, collapsing thousands of membership checks into one succinct knoll of trust. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
